ROBED EXPLORER — a single robed humanoid figure in a long flowing coat or cloak, hood up or down, simple boots, no visible weapon. Reads as scholar, pilgrim, or wanderer. Worn fabric texture, weathered traveler

VAC-SUIT SCIENTIST — humanoid in a sealed lightweight space suit (Ad Astra / Interstellar aesthetic, not bulky Apollo), helmet with reflective gold visor, instrument pack on hip, slim cables. Reads as researcher far from home

ARMORED FIGURE — humanoid in plated combat armor (Halo / Mass Effect / Dune-Sardaukar fused aesthetic), helm visor glowing, weapon holstered, weathered carbon-fiber plating. Reads as veteran or sentinel
DESERT NOMAD — hooded humanoid in layered dust-cloak with face-wrap, walking staff or rifle slung, sandstorm-weathered. Reads as Dune Fremen or Tatooine moisture farmer without using franchise nouns
ALIEN CREATURE BIPED — a non-human sentient biped — elongated limbs, smooth or chitinous skin, asymmetric features, no human ancestry visible. Reads as native to this world
ALIEN QUADRUPED — large four-legged native creature with distinctive silhouette — finned spine, crystal horns, bioluminescent markings. Not predator-coded — present as part of the world
TINY EXPLORATION SHUTTLE — a single sleek craft, smaller than a fighter, design DNA biological-organic or crystalline-faceted, glowing thrusters. Reads as the vehicle that brought the explorer
MID-SIZE FREIGHTER — weathered cargo hauler with visible holds and bracing, NOT navy-grey-military, ribbed-shell or barnacle-encrusted DNA, lit from running lights. Reads as working ship
ELEGANT YACHT — graceful crystalline or organic-curve craft (Banks Culture-coded), no visible engines, smooth ambient glow. Reads as wealthy visitor or diplomatic
CRYSTALLINE SHIP — geometric crystal-faceted craft, no traditional hull seams, faceted light playing across its surfaces. Reads as utterly alien design language
ORACLE FIGURE — humanoid in flowing ceremonial robes with arms partially raised or extended, golden or silver accents, glowing eyes or aura. Reads as ritual / prophet / channeler — NOT a fighter
AUTOMATON / SYNTHETIC — bipedal robot or android figure, slim humanoid proportions, exposed servo joints, articulated hands, glowing optic. Reads as a mind in a body, not a tool
